title: Lord, Thy Word Abideth
description: Lord, Thy Word Abideth in Tonic Solfa to RAVENSHAW: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the six verses, and a piano.
about: Henry W. Baker wrote these words for Hymns Ancient and Modern (1861). The tune RAVENSHAW was arranged by William Henry Monk in 1861 from a melody in Michael Weisse’s hymn book of 1531.
underlay: Lord, Thy Word a-bid-eth, And our foot-steps guid_-eth; Who its truth be-liev_-eth Light and joy re-ceiv-eth.

lines: When our foes are near us,
Then Thy Word doth cheer us,
When the storms are o’er us,
Lord, may love and fear Thee,
